teacher: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, self-hosted on the user's Modal endpoint (OpenAI-compatible chat completions)
prompt: system prompt = spec/LABELING.md label definitions + meme/idol/anime rules; asks for type, genre, vclass, confidence 0-1 and the named entity
inputs: title, artist/channel, site, duration only (the same information the small model sees)
tokens_used: at least 2.37 million (sum of the runs that printed a total: 1.55M pool + 0.65M extra pool + 0.17M evaluation sets; the label audit did not print its total)

distillation_filters.override_rule: drop disputed hand-written rows; relabel rule-labelled chart rows

hybrid_rule: hand the item to the teacher when the small model's combined confidence (type x genre/vclass) is below 0.9
credential_handling: kept in a temporary file outside the project, passed via environment variable at run time; not in any project file or commit
